verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents that automated tasks are 'described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final' (puzzle-docs-17), and that AI Close agents surface discrepancies for review (puzzle-docs-24). That covers a review step for automation output. Custom rules exist (puzzle-docs-6), but nothing shows versioning or rollback of the rules or automations themselves. missing for 10: version history for rules/automations, rollback of automation definitions or their applied effects, review/diff of automation changes, independent corroboration.
